title: Uplift Desk Position Log Standing Minutes Leaderboard
dataSources: Pomodoro focus sessions (`pomofocus:session`), desk position logs (`upliftdesk:desk`), Elgato Key Light usage (`elgato:keylight`), calendar meetings (`calendar:event`), and Stretchly breaks (`stretchly:break`).
app: Pomofocus sessions, Uplift desk position logs, Elgato Key Light telemetry, Stretchly break reminders, and meeting calendar events sent to Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=upliftdesk:desk standing_minutes=*
| stats sum(standing_minutes) as total_value, avg(standing_minutes) as avg_value by desk_profile
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks desk profile values by total and average standing minutes across Uplift desk position log events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `standing_minutes` values for each Uplift desk position log event and review total and average standing minutes by desk profile.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total standing minutes.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which desk profile shows the biggest standing minutes numbers in your Uplift desk position log data.
